name: VA-03
label: Safe D

key_factors: District's strong Democratic lean of D+18
Long-serving incumbent Bobby Scott running for reelection
Prediction markets price Democratic win at 95%
model.rationale: Bobby Scott holds a heavily Democratic district and has a massive fundraising edge over Edwin Rivera, who has raised under $7,000. With no competitive polling or expert ratings suggesting otherwise, the fundamentals point to an easy Democratic hold.
model.watch: Any unexpected incumbent scandal or withdrawal would be the main route to a closer race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Bobby Scott seeks another term in a Hampton Roads–area district that leans Democratic by about 18 points. He is a long-tenured incumbent with the advantages of name recognition and party support in a seat Democrats have held for decades.

His Republican challenger, Edwin Rivera, has raised only about $6,600 and has minimal cash on hand, leaving no realistic path to close the gap. Two independent candidates are on the ballot but lack meaningful resources. Prediction markets price a Democratic win at roughly 95%, consistent with the fundamentals. This race is rated Safe D, with the only uncertainty being the size of the margin rather than the winner.
